goal.calcHint: Just a suggestion. Your goal above stays untouched until you apply it.
goal.medical: Rule of thumb based on weight and age, height counts a little. A rough guide, not medical advice.
goal.extraHint: Sport on Tuesdays, for instance: extra on top of the daily goal.
amounts.hint: Pick 1 to 5 sizes for the quick buttons on the home screen.
amounts.count: {n} of 5 selected. At least one has to stay.
unit.hint: Only the display changes. Everything is still stored in millilitres, so your entries stay intact.
notif.hint: Arrives silently, no sound and no vibration, showing your still empty bar.
notif.unsupported: This browser has no notifications. On iPhone they only work once the app is installed.
notif.denied: Blocked. Only the browser settings can unblock it.
notif.granted: Allowed. The reminder arrives once your device wakes the app in the background.
notif.default: The reminder is on, the browser will ask for permission on your first tap.
about.data: Goal, sizes and everything you drink stay on your device. No account, no sign-in.
about.analytics: Cloudflare Web Analytics counts anonymous page views, no cookies.
about.confirm: Delete goal, sizes and everything you have logged?
guide.title: Setup
guide.intro: Add Drink to your home screen. Only then does it open full screen and get to remind you while closed.
guide.introDone: Drink is already on your home screen. Here is how to do it on another device.
guide.ios1: Open this page in Safari. Other browsers on iPhone are not allowed to send reminders.
guide.ios2: Tap the share icon at the bottom, the square with the arrow.
guide.ios3: Scroll down the list to Add to Home Screen.
guide.ios5: Start Drink from the home screen and allow the reminder.
guide.iosNote: Notifications work from iOS 16.4 on, but only for the installed app.
guide.android2: Tap the three dots in the top right.
guide.android3: Choose Install app, older versions call it Add to Home screen.
guide.android5: Start Drink from the home screen and allow the reminder.
guide.androidNote: Only as an installed app can Drink wake up in the background and remind you in the morning.
guide.desktop2: Click the install icon on the right of the address bar.
guide.desktop4: Drink then runs in its own window.
guide.desktopNote: On a computer the reminder shows as a system notification while Drink is running.
